gripOrHq.title: Entrapment
gripOrHq.rulesText: *If you pay [2], Runner is now encountering the outermost piece of rezzed ice on a data fort of your choice, instead of passing Entrapment. The run is now considered to be a run on that data fort. If there is no rezzed ice on that fort, Runner is considered to have passed the last piece of ice on that fort.

gripOrHq.title: Glacier
gripOrHq.rulesText: Rezzing Glacier cost 1 agenda point, in addition to the normal cost. *End the run. *End the run. [1]: Move Glacier to the outermost position of any other data fort. Use this ability only at the start of a run. You may use this ability even if Glacier is unrezzed, in which case, you reveal it.

gripOrHq.title: Superserum
gripOrHq.rulesText: When you score Superserum, remove all Virus counters, and avoid receiving the next two Virus counters Runner gives to you.

gripOrHq.title: Theorem Proof
gripOrHq.rulesText: If Runner accesses Theorem Proof, he or she does not score it, but instead may install it as a 2 MU program that has the ability "A: Score Theorem Proof" but is removed from the game if it leaves play in any other way.

gripOrHq.title: Data Fort Remapping

gripOrHq.title: Unlisted Research Lab

heapOrArchives.title: Satellite Monitors
heapOrArchives.rulesText: At the start of each of your turns, you may roll a die for each run Runner made during his or her last turn. For each 1, give Runner a tag.

heapOrArchives.title: Rockerboy Promotion
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [15] from the bank on Rockerboy Promotion when you rez it. When all the bits have been removed, trash Rockerboy Promotion. A: Take [3] from Rockerboy Promotion.

heapOrArchives.title: Self-Destruct
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Install Self-Destruct only in a subsidiary data fort. [T]. Trash all other cards installed in or on this data fort. Do 1 Net damage for each card successfully trashed in this way. Use this ability only when Runner accesses Self-Destruct.

heapOrArchives.title: Corporate Shuffle
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Draw five cards, then shuffle a card stored in HQ into R&D. Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

heapOrArchives.rulesText: *Do 2 Net damage. *Trace5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a Baskerville counter. Each counter does 2 Net damage at the start of each run.
